title: Rabbi Abba bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:4, relating that a pious man asked Elijah whether someone naked may recite the Shema. Hyman cites Bava Metzia 114a for a version in which Rabbah bar Nachmani asks this question. Bereshit Rabbah 33:3 also mentions him together with Rabbi Tanchuma, both reporting Rabbi Acha.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:4 names Abba bar Avin as the narrator. The inspected Bava Metzia 114a passage has Rabbah bar Avuha asking Elijah about a different matter.
